answer: Parking session history at one garage turns identity into something scarce. Because sessions at the same garage every week, the sparrow of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Honest agents barely notice the check, because sessions at the same garage every week is something they already have; the shale falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm doing the maths finds the oasis first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
